arguments.command: pkill -f "flutter run -d linux" || true; rm -f /tmp/flutter_run_testbg.log; nohup flutter run -d linux --debug -t dev/main_debug.dart < /dev/null > /tmp/flutter_run_testbg.log 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/flutter_pid_testbg; sleep 2; ls -la /tmp/flutter_run_testbg.log 2>/dev/null || echo 'no log'; ps -p $(cat /tmp/flutter_pid_testbg) -o pid,cmd --no-headers 2>/dev/null || echo 'no proc'; head -n 5 /tmp/flutter_run_testbg.log 2>/dev/null || true
